title: November
format: Vertical 9:16, about 45 seconds, 1080 by 1920 at 24 fps, wordless, no music
logline: The second week of November in a small harbor town: the last ship is hauled up and put to bed for the winter, and the sailor comes home with the steering oar on his shoulder. Then the winter: he sits at the window with a cup looking at a sea he cannot use, and she works around him.
overall: Published 2026-11-02 as a YouTube Short (https://youtube.com/shorts/1X6r40Ld7Hw). v3 (42.2 s), approved by the director, is the film; its 4K master is the published master. The workspace is archived under the standard retention. Sixteen Veo takes, all first attempts, no retakes bought. No music.
next: Nothing open. Future edits start from a restored copy of the archive.

scenes.title: The sea closes
scenes.summary: Grey morning in a small harbor town. The last ship comes in and the crew puts it to bed for the winter in a chain of close procedures: the haul up the rollers, the stones, the plug worked out of the hull so the water runs, the wet sail folded. Then the beach of hulls with the water empty, and at dusk the man climbs the lane with the steering oar on his shoulder while a goose crosses in front of him. Wordless.

segments.title: V01 The last ship comes in under a grey sky, sail coming down
segments.detail: Director 2026-11-02: end at source 4.083 s (frame 98). v2 uses source 64-98: the ship rides in and the sail starts down. Anchor refs/P1.png.

segments.title: V02 The haul: five backs on the ropes, the hull slides up the rollers
segments.detail: v2: picture reversed locally on the director's note so the men back away from the hull on the ropes (reversed clip 26-104, the take's forward sound). Anchor refs/P2.png.

segments.title: V03 Stones wedged against the hull
segments.detail: v3: now follows the plug, on the director's continuity note (the stones packed round the hull must not vanish when the plug comes out). Source 0-42. Anchor refs/P3.png.

segments.title: V04 The plug worked out of the hull; the water runs out onto the shingle
segments.detail: v3: now precedes the stones (director 2026-11-02). Native: the plug squeaks, comes free at 60, water runs from 88 (source 34-130). Anchor refs/P4.png.

segments.title: V05 The wet sail folded on the shingle
segments.detail: Generated and kept: the sail edge lifted and folded over (source 32-74). Anchor refs/P5.png.

segments.title: V06 The beach of hulls, the water empty
segments.detail: Generated and kept: only the waves move; not one boat on the water (source 20-74). Anchor refs/P6.png.

segments.title: V07 Dusk: up the lane with the steering oar; the goose crosses
segments.detail: Generated and kept: the oar blade sweeps in from the bottom edge, his back fills the frame, he climbs away; the goose appears at the wall and climbs beside his leg rather than crossing in front (source 20-98). I keep the goose that follows him. Anchor refs/P7.png.

scenes.title: The finding
scenes.summary: She opens the door, they hold each other, the door shuts on the wind and the sea drops out of the sound. At the shrine the small bronze woman holds her own steering oar; a rattle is shaken once. He lays the real oar on the pegs over the hearth, in the smoke.

segments.title: V08 The door: she opens, they hold, the door swings shut on the wind
segments.detail: Generated and kept, native: he steps in, they meet (their faces touch for a third of a second, not a staged kiss), the hold; the right door leaf swings shut on picture and the native track lands the thud with the wind under the open door before it (source 32-136, 104 frames). The oar leans by the door and stays. Anchor refs/P8d.png.

segments.title: V09 The niche: the bronze figure with her steering oar; the rattle once
segments.detail: Generated and kept: the figure clear, the hand with the rattle enters and shakes it before her (source 8-44). Anchor refs/P9.png.

segments.title: V10 The steering oar laid on the pegs over the hearth
segments.detail: Generated and kept: the oar settles level on the pegs, he lets go and looks at it (source 16-64); cut before a wooden stump materialises by the hearth as he turns to leave. Anchor refs/P10b.png.

scenes.title: The winter
scenes.summary: Rain. He sits at the small window with a cup looking down at a sea he cannot use; she works the loom behind him. The jug tips into the cup. She carries the water jar and has to step over his legs; he does not move. He goes down to the beach in the rain and puts his hand on the hull. Night: he is asleep against the wall with the cup tipped in his lap, and she is still at the loom. The oar over the low fire, smoke past the blade. Nothing is said.

segments.title: V11 Rain: he at the window with the cup; she at the loom behind him
segments.detail: Generated and kept, native: a long draught with the cup at his lips; she works the warp, then the weaving sword (source 4-82). No speech. Anchor refs/P11.png.

segments.title: V12 Insert: the jug tips into the cup
segments.detail: Generated and kept, native: the pour (source 0-42). Anchor refs/P12.png.

segments.title: V13 She steps over his outstretched legs with the water jar; he does not move
segments.detail: Director 2026-11-02: start at source 4.625 s (frame 111). v2 uses source 111-164: she is already at his legs mid-step, steps over, sets the jar down by his feet. He does not move his legs; he watches her (the anchor looked out of the window). Anchor refs/P13b.png.

segments.title: V14 Rain on the beach: his hand flat on the hauled-up hull, the water empty
segments.detail: Generated and kept: hand flat on the hull, the hand drops, he keeps looking at the empty water (source 20-80). Rain is not visible in the take; the sound carries it. Anchor refs/P14.png.

segments.title: V15 Night: he asleep against the wall, the cup tipped in his lap; she still at the loom
segments.detail: Generated and kept, native: he sleeps slumped with the cup; she beats the weft by lamplight (source 40-112). Anchor refs/P15.png.

segments.title: V16 The oar over the low fire, smoke past the blade; the loom under it; cut to black
segments.detail: Generated and kept: the oar on the pegs over the embers, the smoke climbing past the blade (source 20-80); cuts to black. Anchor refs/P16c.png (the close); the whole room at night, refs/P16b.png, exists as an alternate ending.

decisions.title: No music
decisions.detail: Director 2026-11-02: leaning to none, ambient wind and life only, open to a suggestion. Agent: agreed and built that way. The loom is the only rhythm in the second half and it is hers; a score would tell the viewer how to feel about the marriage. The one made sound is the rattle, once. Director 2026-11-02, after the v2 swap of the plug and the stones: "Excellent work", proceed with the 4K; the cut stands as built.

decisions.title: C4: his hand on the hull in the rain (agent's addition)
decisions.detail: One exterior inside the winter: he goes down to the beached ship in the rain. Missing the sea made physical, and it keeps him from reading as a villain. Cut it if the winter should stay indoors. Director 2026-11-02, after the v2 swap of the plug and the stones: "Excellent work", proceed with the 4K; the cut stands as built.

decisions.title: The Pleiades opener is dropped
decisions.detail: The spine's A1 (stars going out over the western sea) costs a take and a composite; the director asked for the ship's details. The Vegetius line goes in the description. Say the word and it comes back as a 3 s opener. Director 2026-11-02, after the v2 swap of the plug and the stones: "Excellent work", proceed with the 4K; the cut stands as built.

decisions.title: Reshoot priorities after the first watch
decisions.detail: The hold at the door (B1), the step over his legs (C3) and the night (C5) are the takes most likely to want a second attempt. The ledger holds a reserve for about five. Director 2026-11-02, after the v2 swap of the plug and the stones: "Excellent work", proceed with the 4K; the cut stands as built.

decisions.title: C3: he watches her step over his legs
decisions.detail: The anchor had him looking out of the window; the take turned his head to her, so he watches her carry the jar over his legs and does not move. Colder than the spine. Keep, or retake with the gaze pinned to the window (one 8 s audio take from the reserve). Director 2026-11-02, after the v2 swap of the plug and the stones: "Excellent work", proceed with the 4K; the cut stands as built.

decisions.title: A2: the hull barely moves on the rollers
decisions.detail: The five men heave and lean and the ropes strain, but the hull gains little on the slipway in the kept window. The effort reads; the movement does not. Keep, or retake (one 6 s audio take). Director 2026-11-02: "Try reversing the motion on V02. Right now they're walking towards the boat when dragging it in." Done in v2: the picture is reversed locally (the take's forward sound kept), so the five men back away from the hull on the ropes.

decisions.title: C6: the close of the oar, or the empty room at night
decisions.detail: Built with the close (the oar over the embers, as the spine wrote it). An alternate anchor exists of the whole room at night with nobody in it and the oar on the wall; it would cost one 4 s take. Director 2026-11-02, after the v2 swap of the plug and the stones: "Excellent work", proceed with the 4K; the cut stands as built.

log.text: Planned: brief pulled in, sixteen-take plan over three sections, the card rendered, sixteen motion prompts and the first wave of nine image requests written; wave 1 generating.

Anchors: harbor, slipway, hull, the sailor at the plug (character reference), sail, beach of hulls, lane, room, the wife at the door (character reference), niche, hearth, window, pour, legs, beach in rain, night, oar at night. Veo wave 1 (A1-A7, B2): eight of eight kept. Wave 2 (interiors) submitted.
Veo wave 2 (B1, B3, C1-C6): eight of eight kept. Gate complete: sixteen takes, no retakes. Trial mix measured per section; levels corrected; v1 soundtrack rendered.
v1 assembled (1082 frames, -21.9 LUFS) with the review overlay; 720p copy on the page player.
Director's notes on v1: V01 end at src 98, V02 motion reversed, V13 start at src 111. v2 cut (1013 frames, 42.2 s) and assembled.
Director on v2: swap V03 and V04 so the stones do not vanish under the hull; "Excellent work", proceed with the 4K. v3 assembled (plug, then stones; 1013 frames) and the 4K finishing pass started.

v3 approved; 4K master rendered (model pass per segment, Lanczos blend, tags completed, audio identical to v3). Description written with the verified passages from Vegetius 4.39, Pliny 2.125, Codex Theodosianus 13.9.3 and Hesiod 618-632.
4K finishing master delivered: final/november_2026_v3_4k.mp4 (2160 by 3840, 1013 frames, the v3 soundtrack byte-identical). Ready for upload.

Closeout: ledger reconciled, library analysis and private backup complete, workspace archived and resealed after the standard retention (78 intermediate renders removed; the 4K master, the v3 source cut, every take, stem, reference and recipe kept), source committed.
